blocking_methods.label: tollFree
blocking_methods.instructions: Call 1800 - 309 - 5790 and follow the IVR to hotlist the card.
Email cardpayment@wbstcb.bank.in from your registered email to request card blocking.
Log in to internet banking at https://www.wbstcb.bank.in and use the card block/hotlist option.

Customer Care / Helpline toll-free 1800 - 309 - 5790 (integrated with Head Office EPABX; the bank's debit-card safety booklet prints the same number as 18003095790), plus chargeable Kolkata lines 033 - 4004 2721 (head-office 'Contact No.') and H.O. EPABX (033) 221 - 00000 / (033) 2225 - 2225; no service hours are published for any line and no overseas number is published. Published lost/stolen-card action (DOs & DON'Ts of ATM cum Debit Card, item 15): immediately inform the Bank; if the card is held by an ATM, inform the Bank Branch as well as the Helpline 18003095790, and email customerservices.card@wbstcb.com and cardpayment@wbstcb.com plus the respective home branch at bm.branchname@wbstcb.com; the contact page separately publishes cardpayment@wbstcb.bank.in under 'for ATM/ Debit Card'. No SMS block keyword/short code, no in-app block menu and no netbanking card-block option are published on any checked official page: WBSCB Mobile Banking exists ('download latest version.. from Google Play Store only' per the mobile-banking privacy policy, but no store URL is published on the site) and the internet-banking portal inb.wbstcb.bank.in/OnlineWBSCB/ offers Retail/Corporate logins, yet neither page documents a card-blocking self-service path, so the published channels are the helpline, the card emails and the home branch. The bank's own pages do not mention the 1930 cybercrime helpline. No winding-up, liquidation or licence-cancellation notice appears on the site; the bank is publishing current notices and audited annual accounts 2025-26.

No credit-card product or credit-card blocking channel is published anywhere on the official site checked live: the Products menu, the downloads/forms list (the only card form is 'Form 2 Application for ATM card'), the notices page and the site's own sitemap (288 URLs) contain no credit-card page, and the only card product evidenced is the ATM-cum-Debit Card (debit-card safety booklet; contact page publishes a card email only under 'for ATM/ Debit Card'). The earlier published entry's credit-card channels (toll-free 1800-345-0001, email info@wbpcb.co.in, website login) appear nowhere on the current official site, and the domain cited as their source (www.wbpcb.co.in) does not resolve at all (NXDOMAIN, live DNS check 2026-11-01); treat the entire prior credit entry as unverifiable boilerplate.
